feeds.title: Tallgrass Sudbury School Blog
feeds.description: Articles on alternative to conventional education, freedom and responsibility. Tallgrass Sudbury School serves students ages 5 to 18. It is one of about 50 schools worldwide modeled after the Sudbury philosophy of education, pioneered by Sudbury Valley School.

feeds.title: The Circle School Blog
feeds.description: Read about Integral education for children and teens ages 4-18.The Circle School is an independent self-directed democratic school in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. An alternative to public and traditional private schools, founded in 1984, serve approximately 70 to 90 preschool, elementary, and high school-aged children.

feeds.title: Progressive Education
feeds.description: Read articles on why we need progressive alternatives to conventional methods in education, provides information on what the alternative approaches are, and shares the changes that people want to see within state education at Progressive Education.

feeds.title: The Open School Blog
feeds.description: Keep updated with articles on students growth in democratic and self directed learning school. The Open School is a K-12 self-directed democratic school. It is an institution founded on the principles of genuine freedom and personal autonomy.

feeds.title: Sligo Sudbury School
feeds.description: Read articles on self directed learning, alternative education and democratic environment. Sligo Sudbury School is a place where young people aged 5-18 can learn through play and experience at their own pace, in their own time and in their own way.

feeds.title: Fairhaven School Blog
feeds.description: Articles about democratic education, self-directed learning and alternative school. At Maryland's First Sudbury School no one imposes curriculum on the students, no matter how tempting it may be. The school's emphasis on innovation and self-motivation provides students with the best possible preparation for an ever-changing future in the 21st century.

feeds.title: West Cork Sudbury School Blog
feeds.description: Read about the democratic school, self-directed learning, monumental and continuing journey of West Cork Sudbury School. The West Cork Sudbury School is part of a movement towards a very different model of education, where children decide what and how they learn and have a very active role in the running of the school itself.

feeds.title: Alpine Valley School Blog
feeds.description: The blog features articles about democratic education, self-directed learning, alternative school, metro Denver Colorado, Wheat Ridge Colorado, childhood development, learning and schooling. Alpine Valley School is a private day school serving students from K-12. It follows the Sudbury model of education, which relies on students' natural curiosity and creativity.

feeds.title: Longview School
feeds.description: Posts on self learning, differentiated instruction and inquiry-based learning. Longview School is a pre-K through 12th grade nonprofit, NY State recognized, private school. At Longview, students are expected to act appropriately in classes and activities: that is just a typical part of growing up and adjusting to life in a school community.

feeds.title: Sudbury Valley School Blog
feeds.description: Keep updated with self learning and democratic schooling at Sudbury Vally School. In the vibrant community at Sudbury Valley, students from pre-school through high school age explore the world freely at their own pace and in their own unique ways. They are responsible for designing their path to adulthood.

feeds.title: Passages Centre for Self-Directed Learning Blog
feeds.description: Read articles on differentiated instruction, inquiry-based learning and self directed learning. Passages Centre mentors youth to self-direct their education and create a personalized learning experience an alternative to mainstream school. They are a community for youth to dive deep into interests, hobbies and courses at their own pace.

feeds.title: Miami Sudbury School Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with self directed and democratic learning.The Miami Sudbury School is a K-12 democracy where young people have human and civil rights. Their mission is to promote the curiosity, dignity, and growth of all students of every background and ability level through a uniquely-effective method that combines trust and accountability.

feeds.title: The Hive: Self-Directed Learning For Teens
feeds.description: Articles on self inspired and democratic learning. The Hive is a Self-Directed Learning for Teens an alternative to school in Eugene Oregon. The Hive is a member of the Liberated Learners Network.
